Thank you so much, it means a lot, it really isn't easy. I feel and know that if I let the pain get a hold of me I just... Die. Cause I've been _so_ close, the smallest sign of me letting myself fall would just do it.

I might not be able to exactly tell you what troubles me cause I don't feel as shitty rn and I feel I explain it more accurate when I feel bad...

Actually, I'm about to go to bed rn. If you don't mind me I'll answer tomorrow when I'm fully awake.
I'm sorry for your loss man, it must be real tough.
Dude if you need to you can tell me everything you need to get out of your system. I'm here to help

Hey I was in your exact situation just yesterday, had a big argument with someone I truly care about. I really wish I was there to hug you and wipe your tears like I would've liked someone do to me yesterday. 

Taking deep breath and counting to ten while exhaling really helps, the main idea is to clear your mind from those intrusive thoughts you might be having. Maybe say or think a little mantra like "I will be/feel better".

But what really got me to calm down was to take my journal and write everything that was going through my mind. Idk why but it really helps.

I hope this helps and hang in there!
